Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. The operation families repeat their conventions: CreateValidators (with MaxCountValidator over Constants.MaxMainGroups / MaxMiddleGroupsInMainGroup or FreeGroupRangeAddressStrategyValidator), the Create* DOM-object factories, the Move*/Apply* undo-redo triples and the SetDescription helper that sets the description from a neutral localized resource text.
Method.duplicates: SplitFreeGroupRangeOperation's four predicates are two byte-identical pairs: b(FreeGroupRange) and a(FreeGroupRange) are the same body, as are b(IGroupAddress) and a(IGroupAddress), so one of each pair is named (IsAtOrAfterSplitAddress / IsAddressAtOrAfterSplitAddress) and the twin is left unresolved.
Method.log strings: MoveFreeGroupRangeOperation logs 'Moving free group ranges' and MoveThreeLevelMiddleGroupOperation logs 'Moving three level middle groups'.
